item.title: 4 British Men Convicted of Sexually Assaulting Joanne Young
item.description: A jury rejected the men’s defense that they had been relying on assurances from Joanne Young’s husband — who himself has pleaded guilty to rape — that she had consented.

item.title: After Bridge Attack, Putin Says He Will ‘Not Be Negotiating’ Ukraine Cease-Fire
item.description: The Russian leader invited European representatives to Moscow to discuss giving them a role in negotiations. It was unclear how serious the offer was.

item.title: Myanmar Genocide Ruling Sets Up Court Fight Over Israel and Gaza
item.description: The ruling by the International Court of Justice deals with issues relevant to the case brought against Israel alleging genocide in Gaza. Israel has rejected the charge.

item.title: White Police Officers Are Convicted of Beating a Black Man in France
item.description: The three officers were filmed beating Michel Zecler, a music producer, inside his Paris studio in 2020, setting off a national backlash.

item.title: Denmark Expels Russian Diplomat After Accusing Moscow of Planning a Hit
item.description: Danish officials say Russian intelligence services recruited members of a violent gang to try to assassinate a Ukrainian rapper at a concert outside Copenhagen.
